items.bodyText:

Thanks for applying to the Summer 2027 Software Engineering Internship at Nimbus. The next step is a 90-minute online assessment on CodeSignal (two coding questions, one short design question).

Please complete it within 5 days of this email. You have 5 days from today, so please finish by Tuesday, November 17 at 11:59 PM PT. The link is personal to you:
